text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALE - The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association bought a 54,000 tonne shipment of Brazilian soybeans from Peavey at tender on Thursday.

WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - Japan's Food Agency said Thursday it had bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 40,000 of Canadian wheat and 20,000 of Australian barley in its weekly tender. All the purchases are for July shipment.
WHEAT SALE - U.S. exporters reported sales of 250,000 tonnes of soft red winter wheat to Egypt for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year, USDA said.
WHEAT TENDER - Pakistan will seek 376,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or Australian white wheat on May 28, according to a Pakistan embassy official. The shipment period was slated for June 11-July 10.

- South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd would jointly invite tenders to buy a total of 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday, traders said. Shipment was set for July 1-31 to the port of Pusan.

WHEAT TENDERS - South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd would invite tenders to buy 25,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday, traders said. Shipment was set for July 20-August 20 to the western port of Inchon.
- A Philippine flour miller turned down bids to supply 7,500 tonnes of U.S. western white wheat as a result of high prices, traders said on Thursday.
- The CCC seeks 13,500 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat, maximum moisture 13.5 percent, for donation to Pakistan. Offers were to be submitted on May 22. Shipment was for June 10-July 15.
- Results are awaited on this week's Iraq's tender for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for July shipment under a United Nations oil-for-food deal.
RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs seeks offers June 4 to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for July with confirmation on June 12.
RICE TENDERS - The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by May 26 for the export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent broken.
- Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice on May 21 for June delivery

MARKET TALK - Argentine exporters are doing a bumper trade in soybean and sunflower seed oils, with China leading a pack of Asian buyers seeking soyoil, traders said Thursday. Brazil and Argentina between them are shipping a total of about 500,000 tonnes a month of soybean oil and sunflower seed oil, traders said. China is taking about a third, with other big buyers including Iran, India, Pakistan and Bangladesh.
